requirement_text.GH#2682: REVIEWER code gate for PR a of the exam content snapshot (commit ff42bea87). Read-only review; no mix run.

task.description: REVIEWER code gate for GH #2682 PR a: idiom, module boundaries, scope creep, decision-record consistency, deviations D-1..D-8.

result.summary: PASS (no blocking change). 1 IDIOM/OTP: no process machinery is introduced or needed (REQ-045 row-lock model unchanged; InstanceSupervisor untouched). Snapshot is a pure functional module, with-chains and typed {:error, {:grading_error, reason}}, total parsers, no raise on stored data; Rollout copies Stamp's shape (per-tenant transaction, tag-only errors, rescue to a report). Session carry-forward (Map.merge(session.field_values, ...) at session.ex update_session_after_submit) is correct for the full-replacement update_record; the only other session writer is create (anti_cheat.ex only reads the session; Session.submit from the anti-cheat branch surfaces the new typed errors, which render_report_event handles). Rollback of score_and_persist errors inside Repo.transaction leaves the session in_progress as designed. 2 D-4 ACCEPTED: lib/letflow/release/** reaching exam code via Catalog.fetch("exam") plus Exam.snapshot_rollout/1 and snapshot_verify/0 is the sanctioned route (same as Stamp reaching the exam manifest); the design's file layout violated check_boundaries rule 5, so the deviation is correct and the DESIGN should be amended (doc note). The Exam <-> Snapshot.Rollout reference is runtime-only (alias for a spec plus a delegate), no compile cycle. 3 D-2 ACCEPTED, DESIGN AMENDMENT REQUIRED (doc-only): Scoring moduledoc lines ~40-41 states :question_without_correct_option applies only to single/true_false/multiple, and likert/short_text have no correct-option concept; Snapshot.check_key/3 (@key_types = single multiple truefalse) plus build_likert/3 (non-empty options map, parsable weight, polarity positive|negative) and to_scoring_questions/likert_options are exactly consistent with Scoring (and stricter than the old code, where a nil weight/polarity raised FunctionClauseError in to_float/polarity_atom). The design text is self-contradictory: design 7.2 / section on {:key_missing,_} (line ~300) and T-17 (line ~539) say 'non-shorttext question needs a correct option', while line ~195 and the likert clause of T-17 say likert needs complete likert_options. The literal reading would fail every likert exam at start, so the implementation is right; CODE-DESIGNER (or the PR a body) must restate: key_missing = single/multiple/truefalse with no correct option, OR likert with empty/incomplete likert_options; shorttext needs neither. TEST-DESIGNER must write T-17 to the implemented rule (include: likert with correct-option rows still builds; likert with zero options -> key_missing; shorttext with zero options builds). 4 OTHER DEVIATIONS: D-1 (map 4th arg) accepted, spec and typedoc present, update design 4.2 table. D-3 verified (Response.service_unavailable/2 exists, response.ex:421; Response.internal_error/2 exists, :417). D-5 (all-zero system actor, RecordDeadlineSweep precedent) accepted: NOT NULL columns make nil impossible; security-reviewer already folded OQ-2. D-6 accepted: all bodies are constants (@grading_failed_detail, @content_invalid_detail, @upgrading_detail), reason/session id/prefix only in the log, no value ever in a body or log (ids only). D-7 accepted but see dead-code note. D-8 accepted. 5 SCOPE CREEP vs PR b: none of the PR b components exist (no ensure/build_late, no certificate facts, no flag true, no per-tenant Stamp prerequisites, no cutover, Certificate untouched; config.exs=false, test.exs=true as designed). Tiny leakage, non-blocking: Snapshot accepts origins late and late_certificate in @origins and declares :certificate_facts_missing in grading_reason although nothing in PR a produces them; question_item/2 handles the no-questions (late_certificate) case. Acceptable as the shared storage contract (design 4.1) but PR b should not need to widen it. 6 DECISION RECORDS: no conflict (0004 humanless pipeline, REQ-045 row-lock model, 0030 scoring all intact; no new framework). 7 pack/definition: session.json and pack.json both gain exam_snapshot json queried:false required:false with identical description text and a changed logical_shape_version; consistent with the stated generate_pack.exs regeneration (TEST-RUNNER must confirm pack_install_test drift check green; I did not run it). 8 CONFIG: :exam_snapshot_complete only in config.exs (false) and test.exs (true); Stamp reads Application.get_env at call time with a strict != true check (fail closed); no runtime.exs/env path. Good. 9 MIX TASK / RELEASE: letflow.exam_snapshot_rollout strict OptionParser, Mix.Task.run(app.start), tag-only error text, exit 1 on failed/conflict; Release.ExamSnapshot.rollout/1 forwards only :dry_run (Keyword.take). Idiomatic and matches ManagedTypes precedent. NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS for ELIXIR-DEV (fix in this PR if cheap, else follow-up): (F1) dead/unreachable code: Stamp.run/1 returns {:error, :snapshot_not_complete} BEFORE sweeping, and run_tenant/2 re-checks the same flag, so gate_blocked_total (stamp.ex sweep/3) and the 'failed_total > 0 or gate_blocked_total > 0' branch in letflow.stamp_managed_types.ex are reachable only if the flag flips mid-sweep. Keep the run_tenant gate (direct callers) but either drop the counter or document it as a race-only guard; a test cannot reach it without put_env mid-sweep. (F2) Rollback behavior for a pinned question: fetch_pinned_question_row returns {:error, {:question_not_found, id}} (session.ex ~1007-1010) but router.ex has NO render_start_session clause for {:question_not_found, _}, so an archived/missing pin now yields a generic 500 'internal error' on every start of that exam (previously the pin was silently used). Add a start clause mapping it to the constant @content_invalid_detail 500 (or 422), or state in the PR body that it is the intended generic 500; test it. (F3) Snapshot.normalize_number/1 renders D.to_string(normalized, :normal) as a 'representability' proof; for a pathological stored value such as "1e999999999" that string is enormous, and it runs BEFORE the 0..100 range check in threshold_decimal/1 and for every likert weight. passing_score_pct/likert_weight are DECIMAL fields that the entity Validator bounds, so this is authoring-side and low severity, but compare to bounds (or cap the exponent via D.compare / coef-exponent check) before rendering, and add a unit case for 1e999999999. (F4) Stale doc: session.ex moduledoc ~line 398 still says seed_answer_key_field_restrictions!/1 seeds 'exactly those four' rows; exam.ex now lists six pairs. Reword to 'the answer-key rows' (cosmetic). (F5) finalize_expired/3 (system sweep) now returns {:error, {:grading_error, _}} for a snapshotless in_progress session and will retry every sweep tick with a Logger line each time until PR b; confirm the sweep caller tolerates and does not crash-loop on the new tag (I found no non-session caller of finalize_expired in lib; the callback is configured). The PR body must say PR a must not ship to a tenant with in-flight sessions that matter (design line ~597). TYPE-SAFETY (does not block; FINDING per WORK_BOARD section 7): the decoded snapshot is an untyped string-keyed map (@type snapshot :: %{optional(String.t()) => term()}) and the question type string<->atom mapping exists three times (Snapshot @types and type_atom/1, Session.question_type_atom/1). A %Snapshot{} struct with a single decode/1 (validated once at fetch) and an Ecto.Enum-style single type table would make 'item missing a key / bad polarity / unknown type' unrepresentable after fetch instead of re-checked in to_scoring_questions on each call. Candidate: docs/issues/ISS tagged type-safety, owner ELIXIR-DEV, size S-M, only after PR b stabilises the shape (origin late/late_certificate would otherwise churn it).
findings: FINDING (type-safety, non-blocking): Snapshot decoded form is an untyped string-keyed map and the question type table is duplicated 3x; a validated %Snapshot{} struct plus one type table would make invalid snapshots unrepresentable post-fetch. File under docs/issues/ tagged type-safety after PR b.

FINDING (design amendment, doc-only): design 7.2 / key_missing row (~line 300) / T-17 (~line 539) contradict the likert rule at ~line 195; amend to 'single|multiple|truefalse need a correct option; likert needs complete non-empty likert_options; shorttext needs neither', and record D-1 (build_from_resolved/4 info map) and D-4 (release wrapper via Catalog.fetch + Exam delegates, rule 5) in the design.
